description: Delete a matrix for good, with its elements, correlations, KPI readings, update logs and public share links; matrices below it in the cascade are detached. It cannot be undone. Ask the person first, then pass confirm_name: the exact name of the matrix, as list_matrices gives it; any other value is refused (CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH) and nothing is deleted. To set a matrix aside, use archive_matrix.

confirm_name.description: The exact name of the matrix, repeated as a confirmation

name: delete_matrix
